evidence.locator: Overview; docs/cache.md; Getting started; License and citation
evidence.statement: The official data specification organizes OpenScene/nuPlan observations into ordered Scene/Frame objects at 2 Hz for planning agents. NAVSIM evaluates planned future trajectories using explicit simulation-based safety and progress measures.
